name: Sewanee: The University of the South
academic_ranking: Highly selective private national liberal arts college. Ranked #45 among National Liberal Arts Colleges by U.S. News & World Report. ~1,644 undergraduates, 9:1 student-faculty ratio. Notable for producing 26 Rhodes Scholars and numerous Fulbright and Watson fellows.
financial_aid: Per NCES College Navigator (2023-24), 98% of full-time beginning undergraduates received grant or scholarship aid, averaging about $37,171. As an NCAA Division III institution, no athletic scholarships are offered; aid is need-based and merit-based only.
facilities_notes: Softball program plays on the Sewanee (Domain) campus. Specific field/stadium name not published on the softball program page as of 2026-07.
program_reputation: NCAA Division III program competing in the Southern Athletic Association (SAA). Small-roster liberal arts program (15 players for 2026). No standout national reputation identified from public sources.
notes: Data gathered from sewaneetigers.com softball coaches page, roster page, and staff directory (checked 2026-07), plus NCES College Navigator (IPEDS ID 221519, tuition/aid 2024-25 and 2023-24) and Wikipedia (academic rankings). Division III: no athletic scholarships, so scholarship_count is null. Team X/Twitter account is @SoftballSewanee; no individual coach handles publicly listed.
